changes._why: a NULL image_last_updated does not tell a missing picture; order by the missing picture itself, then the date, the name and product_id
request: The web team wants the products that have no picture, or whose picture was last changed before `:since`: those with no picture first, then the oldest picture first; products otherwise tied are ordered by name and `product_id`.
changes.sql:
SELECT product_id, product_name, image_filename, image_last_updated
FROM products
WHERE product_image IS NULL
   OR image_last_updated < :since
ORDER BY CASE WHEN product_image IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, image_last_updated NULLS FIRST, product_name, product_id
